Objects.name: ULSDVOBJ_SYS_LogCtrl_v1
Objects.description: Event log request: which page to place in SYS_LogPage, and maintenance commands. Written only by the tool

variables.name: cmdId
variables.description: Write a new value to run op once; SYS_LogPage cmdEcho echoes it when done

variables.name: page
variables.description: Page of the log to place in SYS_LogPage, 0 = newest

variables.name: key
variables.description: Must be 0xFA175AFE for TestFault, which crashes the device on purpose
